methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched directly via WebFetch for all eight vendors on 2026-06-15 and re-verified: lattice.com/pricing, 15five.com/pricing, leapsome.com/pricing, cultureamp.com/pricing, betterworks.com/pricing, small-improvements.com/pricing, performyard.com/pricing, trakstar.com/pricing. Security/compliance was cross-checked on each vendor's trust/security page. Published per-seat prices (Lattice, 15Five, Small Improvements) and published ranges (PerformYard) were confirmed exactly as listed. Quote-only vendors (Leapsome, Culture Amp, Betterworks, Trakstar) have monthlyUsd=null per methodology — a null beats a guess. Leapsome shows a 'starts at $199/month' label but all module pricing is contact-sales. Compliance flags are true only where the vendor explicitly states the specific certification: Trakstar's soc2 was corrected to null because its security page shows only a generic 'AICPA SOC' badge without specifying SOC 2. accessedAt 2026-06-15 throughout.
